source.text: כִּקְדֹ֧חַ אֵ֣שׁ הֲמָסִ֗ים מַ֚יִם תִּבְעֶה־אֵ֔שׁ לְהוֹדִ֥יעַ שִׁמְךָ֖ לְצָרֶ֑יךָ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ גּוֹיִ֥ם יִרְגָּֽזוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: As fire kindles brushwood, fire makes water boil, to make known your name to your foes; from before you nations will tremble.

en.L: As fire kindles brushwood, [as] fire makes water boil, \q to make known {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} foes; \q from before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} nations will tremble.
en.B: Come down like fire that sets dry brush alight, like fire that brings water to the boil; \q make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name known to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} foes, \q and let the nations tremble before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: Come down like a fire that burns up dry sticks and makes water boil. \q Show {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies who {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are, \q and make the nations shake with fear in front of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: Como el fuego enciende la maleza, [como] el fuego hace hervir el agua, \q para dar a conocer {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} adversarios; \q delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} temblarán las naciones.
es.B: Desciende como el fuego que prende la maleza seca, como el fuego que hace hervir el agua; \q da a conocer {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} adversarios, \q y que las naciones tiemblen delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Baja como un fuego que quema las ramas secas y hace hervir el agua. \q Muéstrales a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos quién eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, \q y haz que las naciones tiemblen de miedo delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: Comme le feu allume les broussailles, [comme] le feu fait bouillir l’eau, \q pour faire connaître {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} adversaires ; \q devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} les nations trembleront.
fr.B: Descends comme le feu qui embrase les broussailles sèches, comme le feu qui fait bouillir l’eau ; \q fais connaître {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} adversaires, \q et que les nations tremblent devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Descends comme un feu qui brûle des branches sèches et qui fait bouillir l’eau. \q Montre à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis qui {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es, \q et fais trembler de peur les nations devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Kama moto uwashavyo vichaka vikavu, [kama] moto uchemshavyo maji, \q ili kulijulisha jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kwa watesi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; \q mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mataifa yatatetemeka.
sw.B: Shuka kama moto unaowasha vichaka vikavu, kama moto unaochemsha maji; \q lijulishe jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kwa adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, \q na mataifa yatetemeke mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Shuka kama moto unaoteketeza vijiti vikavu na kuchemsha maji. \q Waonyeshe adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni nani, \q na kuyafanya mataifa yatetemeke kwa hofu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

vi.L: Như lửa đốt cháy cành khô, [như] lửa làm nước sôi sục, \q để làm cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được biết đến với các kẻ thù {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q các dân tộc sẽ run rẩy trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự xuống như lửa đốt cháy cành khô, như lửa làm nước sôi lên; \q xin làm cho kẻ thù {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và cho các dân tộc run sợ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự xuống như ngọn lửa thiêu cháy cành khô và làm nước sôi lên. \q Xin cho kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là ai, \q và làm cho các dân tộc run sợ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 불이 덤불을 태우듯이, 불이 물을 끓게 하듯이 [내려오셔서], \q 주님의 대적들에게 주님의 이름을 알리십시오. \q 주님 앞에서 민족들이 떨 것입니다.
ko.B: 마른 덤불에 불이 붙듯이, 불이 물을 끓어오르게 하듯이 내려오십시오. \q 주님의 대적들에게 주님의 이름을 알리시고, \q 민족들이 주님 앞에서 떨게 하십시오.
ko.R: 마른 나뭇가지를 태우고 물을 끓게 하는 불처럼 내려오십시오. \q 주님의 원수들에게 주님이 누구신지 보여 주십시오. \q 민족들이 주님 앞에서 두려워 떨게 하십시오.

decisions.choice: Hebrew verse numbers: this is 64:1 in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew text chapter 63 ends with the plea "Oh that you would tear open the heavens and come down" (63:19b), which Bibles following the older Latin and Greek division print as 64:1. So 64:1-11 here are 64:2-12 there. Isaiah is cited by the Hebrew numbers throughout.

decisions.choice: as fire ...: the wish of 63:19b goes on; God is asked to come down as fire comes on what it burns
alternatives: a new comparison standing on its own
decisions.reason: The verse has no main verb of its own. It completes the plea that God would tear open the heavens and come down (63:19b): let him come as fire, so that his name is known and the nations tremble.

decisions.choice: fire and trembling: God's coming at Sinai
decisions.reason: When the LORD came down on Mount Sinai, the mountain smoked with fire and quaked (Exodus 19:18). The prayer asks for that kind of coming again, now so that his enemies learn who he is (Exodus 9:16; Psalm 68:9).

decisions.choice: brushwood: dry twigs and brush that catch fire at once
decisions.reason: The word is rare; it names the small dry growth that burns quickly, the picture of something that cannot stand before fire.

decisions.choice: Come down
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable repeat the plea of 63:19b so that the verse reads as a full sentence. Literal keeps the bare comparison.

decisions.choice: Show your enemies who you are
decisions.reason: To make a name known is to show who someone is and what he can do. Readable says that plainly.

decisions.choice: 64:1 (64:2 in many Bibles)
decisions.reason: Isaiah is numbered as in the Hebrew text: this verse is 64:1 here and 64:2 in many Spanish Bibles; the wish of 63:19b runs on into it.

decisions.choice: 64:1 in the Hebrew numbering
decisions.reason: This verse is 64:1 in the Hebrew and 64:2 in many printed Bibles (meaning decision m1); Swahili keeps the Hebrew numbering, as the English does.

decisions.choice: the people's prayer (63:15-64:11) speaks to God as "Ngài" (spanned) and says "chúng con"
decisions.reason: As the terms note settles for the people praying; "Ngài" is spanned wherever it does not begin a sentence, and the vocative LORD is "lạy CHÚA".

decisions.choice: 64:1 in the Hebrew numbering, continuing the wish of 63:19b in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: Isaiah follows the Hebrew verse numbers, as the English does (m1); the prayer's 합쇼체 begun at 63:14 continues through 64:11.

source.text: בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ֥ נוֹרָא֖וֹת לֹ֣א נְקַוֶּ֑ה יָרַ֕דְתָּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ הָרִ֥ים נָזֹֽלּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: When you did awesome [deeds] [that] we did not wait for, you came down; from before you mountains quaked.

en.L: When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did awesome [deeds] [that] we were not waiting for, \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} came down; \q from before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} mountains quaked.
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did fearsome things beyond all we had hoped, \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} came down, \q and the mountains shook before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did amazing and fearsome things that we never expected, \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} came down, \q and the mountains shook in front of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste [cosas] temibles [que] no esperábamos, \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} descendiste; \q delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} temblaron los montes.
es.B: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste cosas temibles, más allá de todo lo que esperábamos, \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} descendiste, \q y los montes temblaron delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste cosas asombrosas y temibles que nunca esperábamos, \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} bajaste, \q y los montes temblaron delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait des [choses] redoutables [que] nous n’attendions pas, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es descendu ; \q devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} les montagnes ont tremblé.
fr.B: Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait des choses terribles, au-delà de tout ce que nous espérions, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es descendu, \q et les montagnes ont tremblé devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait des choses étonnantes et terribles que nous n’attendions pas, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es descendu, \q et les montagnes ont tremblé devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Ulipotenda [mambo] ya kutisha [ambayo] hatukuyatazamia, \q ulishuka; \q mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} milima ilitetemeka.
sw.B: Ulipofanya mambo ya kutisha kupita yote tuliyoyatumaini, \q ulishuka, \q na milima ikatetemeka mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Ulipofanya mambo ya ajabu na ya kutisha ambayo hatukuyatarajia kamwe, \q ulishuka, \q na milima ikatetemeka mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

vi.L: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm [những việc] đáng sợ [mà] chúng con không trông đợi, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ngự xuống; \q núi non đã rúng động trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm những việc đáng sợ vượt quá mọi điều chúng con mong đợi, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ngự xuống, \q và núi non rung chuyển trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm những việc lạ lùng và đáng sợ mà chúng con chưa bao giờ ngờ tới, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ngự xuống, \q và núi non rung chuyển trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 저희가 기다리지 못한 두려운 일들을 주님께서 행하셨을 때에, \q 주님께서 내려오셨고, \q 주님 앞에서 산들이 진동했습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 저희가 바라던 것보다 훨씬 두려운 일들을 행하셨을 때에, \q 주님께서 내려오셨고, \q 산들이 주님 앞에서 흔들렸습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 저희가 생각지도 못한 놀랍고 두려운 일들을 하셨을 때에, \q 주님께서 내려오셨고, \q 산들이 주님 앞에서 흔들렸습니다.

decisions.choice: when you did ... you came down: God's past acts are recalled
alternatives: when you do awesome things, may you come down
decisions.reason: The verbs are past. The people remember what God once did, above all at the exodus and Sinai, as the ground for asking him to do it again. Some read the verse as part of the wish ("when you do ..., may you come down").

decisions.choice: you came down; mountains quaked before you: the words of 63:19b repeated
decisions.reason: The prayer takes up its own plea from 63:19b and turns it into memory. Mountains trembling when God comes is the language of Sinai and of the old songs (Exodus 19:18; Judges 5:5; Psalm 68:9).

decisions.choice: awesome deeds: acts of God that make people afraid and amazed
decisions.reason: The word is used of God's acts at the exodus (Deuteronomy 10:21; 2 Samuel 7:23).

source.text: וּמֵעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא־שָׁמְע֖וּ לֹ֣א הֶאֱזִ֑ינוּ עַ֣יִן לֹֽא־רָאָ֗תָה אֱלֹהִים֙ זוּלָ֣תְךָ֔ יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִמְחַכֵּה־לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And from long ago they have not heard, they have not given ear; an eye has not seen a God besides you [who] acts for [one who] waits for him.

en.L: And from of old [people] have not heard, they have not listened; \q an eye has not seen a God besides {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} \q [who] acts for [the one who] waits for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Never since time began has anyone heard of it or taken it in; \q no eye has ever seen a God other than {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q one who works for those who wait for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Since the world began, no one has ever heard of any God except {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q and no one has ever seen one. \q Only {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} act to help people who wait for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: Y desde la antigüedad no se ha oído, no se ha escuchado; \q ningún ojo ha visto a un Dios fuera de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} \q [que] obre a favor del que en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} espera.
es.B: Desde que el mundo es mundo nadie lo ha oído ni lo ha percibido; \q ningún ojo ha visto a un Dios aparte de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, \q que actúe a favor de los que esperan en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Desde que el mundo comenzó, nadie ha oído hablar de ningún Dios aparte de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, \q y nadie ha visto jamás a ninguno. \q Solo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} actúas para ayudar a los que esperan en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: Et depuis toujours on n’a pas entendu, on n’a pas prêté l’oreille ; \q aucun œil n’a vu un Dieu en dehors de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} \q [qui] agisse pour [celui qui] {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}attend.
fr.B: Jamais, depuis le commencement, personne n’en a entendu parler ni ne l’a compris ; \q aucun œil n’a jamais vu d’autre Dieu que {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, \q un Dieu qui agit pour ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}attendent.
fr.R: Depuis le début du monde, personne n’a jamais entendu parler d’un autre Dieu que {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, \q et personne n’en a jamais vu. \q Toi seul, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} agis pour aider ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}attendent.

sw.L: Na tangu zamani [watu] hawajasikia, hawajatega sikio; \q jicho halijaona Mungu ila {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} \q [ambaye] hutenda kwa ajili ya [yule] anayemngojea.
sw.B: Tangu mwanzo wa nyakati hakuna aliyesikia habari yake wala kuielewa; \q hakuna jicho lililowahi kumwona Mungu mwingine ila {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, \q anayewatendea kazi wale wanaomngojea.
sw.R: Tangu ulimwengu ulipoanza, hakuna aliyewahi kusikia habari za Mungu mwingine ila {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, \q wala hakuna aliyewahi kumwona. \q Ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} tu unayetenda ili kuwasaidia watu wanaokungojea.

vi.L: Và từ xưa [người ta] chưa từng nghe, chưa từng lắng tai; \q chưa mắt nào thấy một Đức Chúa Trời nào ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q [là Đấng] hành động cho [người] trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Từ thuở nào đến nay chưa ai từng nghe hay hiểu được điều ấy; \q chưa mắt nào thấy một Đức Chúa Trời nào khác ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q là Đấng hành động vì những người trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Từ khi có thế gian, chưa ai từng nghe nói về một Đức Chúa Trời nào khác ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và cũng chưa ai từng thấy. \q Chỉ có {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hành động để giúp những người trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 예로부터 [사람들이] 듣지 못했고, 귀로 듣지도 못했습니다. \q 주님 외에 자기를 기다리는 자를 위하여 일하시는 하나님을 \q 눈이 보지 못했습니다.
ko.B: 세상이 시작된 뒤로 아무도 그런 일을 듣지 못했고, 귀로 들어 본 적도 없습니다. \q 주님 말고는 어떤 하나님도 눈으로 본 적이 없습니다. \q 주님은 주님을 기다리는 사람들을 위하여 일하시는 분이십니다.
ko.R: 세상이 시작된 뒤로 주님 말고 다른 하나님에 대해 들은 사람은 아무도 없습니다. \q 그런 하나님을 본 사람도 없습니다. \q 오직 주님만이 주님을 기다리는 사람들을 도우려고 일하십니다.

decisions.choice: no eye has seen a God besides you: the LORD alone acts for his people
decisions.reason: No one has ever known another God who works on behalf of those who trust him. The LORD's uniqueness is a theme of the whole book (43:10-11; 44:6; 45:21).

decisions.choice: quoted in 1 Corinthians 2:9
decisions.reason: Paul draws on this verse (with words like those of 52:15 and 65:16-17) for "what no eye has seen, nor ear heard ... what God has prepared for those who love him". He applies it to what God has now made known through his Spirit.

decisions.choice: waits for: hopes in God and trusts him to act
decisions.reason: The verb is used of waiting with expectation for God (30:18; Habakkuk 2:3; Daniel 12:12).

decisions.choice: people who wait for you
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from speaking to God ("besides you") to speaking about him ("waits for him"). Readable keeps speaking to God so the sentence stays clear.

decisions.choice: no se ha oído; ningún ojo ha visto
decisions.reason: 1 Corinthians 2:9 draws on this verse; Spanish keeps its key words "ojo", "ver" and "oír" while following the Hebrew order.

decisions.choice: jicho halijaona
decisions.reason: 1 Corinthians 2:9 draws on this verse; "jicho halijaona" keeps its key words, while the rest follows the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "듣지 못했고", "귀", "눈이 보지 못했습니다", "기다리는 자"
alternatives: other wording for hearing and seeing
decisions.reason: 1 Corinthians 2:9 quotes this verse; the Korean keeps the words of eye, ear and waiting so the link can be seen (m2), while following the Hebrew sense.

source.text: פָּגַ֤עְתָּ אֶת־שָׂשׂ֙ וְעֹ֣שֵׂה צֶ֔דֶק בִּדְרָכֶ֖יךָ יִזְכְּר֑וּךָ הֵן־אַתָּ֤ה קָצַ֨פְתָּ֙ וַֽנֶּחֱטָ֔א בָּהֶ֥ם עוֹלָ֖ם וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: You meet [one who] rejoices and does righteousness, in your ways they remember you; look, you were angry and we sinned; in them long [time], and will we be saved?

en.L: You meet [the one who] rejoices and does righteousness, \q [those who] remember {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ways. \q Look, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} were angry, and we sinned; \q in them [we have been] a long [time], and will we be saved?
en.B: You go out to meet the one who delights in doing righteousness, \q those who keep {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in mind as they walk in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ways. \q But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} were angry, and we sinned. \q We have stayed in our sins so long; can we be saved?
en.R: You welcome people who are glad to do what is right \q and who remember how {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want them to live. But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} became angry, and we kept on sinning. \q We have been sinning for a long time. How can we ever be saved?

es.L: Sales al encuentro del que se alegra y practica la justicia, \q [de los que] se acuerdan de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caminos. \q Mira, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} te enojaste, y nosotros pecamos; \q en ellos [hemos estado] largo [tiempo], ¿y seremos salvos?
es.B: Sales al encuentro del que se deleita en practicar la justicia, \q de los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tienen presente cuando andan en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caminos. \q Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} te enojaste, y nosotros pecamos. \q Hemos permanecido tanto tiempo en nuestros pecados; ¿podremos ser salvos?
es.R: Tú recibes con agrado a la gente que se alegra de hacer lo que es justo \q y que recuerda cómo quieres que viva. Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} te enojaste, y nosotros seguimos pecando. \q Hemos estado pecando durante mucho tiempo. ¿Cómo podremos ser salvos alguna vez?

fr.L: Tu vas au-devant de [celui qui] se réjouit et pratique la justice, \q [de ceux qui] se souviennent de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} dans {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} voies. \q Voici, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} t’es irrité, et nous avons péché ; \q [nous sommes] en eux depuis longtemps, et serions-nous sauvés ?
fr.B: Tu vas à la rencontre de celui qui prend plaisir à pratiquer la justice, \q de ceux qui pensent à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} en suivant {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} chemins. \q Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} t’es irrité, et nous avons péché. \q Nous sommes restés si longtemps dans nos péchés ; pourrions-nous être sauvés ?
fr.R: Tu accueilles les gens qui sont heureux de faire ce qui est juste \q et qui se souviennent de la manière dont {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux qu’ils vivent. Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} t’es mis en colère, et nous avons continué à pécher. \q Nous péchons depuis longtemps. Comment pourrions-nous jamais être sauvés ?

sw.L: Unamlaki [yule] anayefurahi na kutenda haki, \q [wale] wanaokukumbuka katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. \q Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulikasirika, nasi tulitenda dhambi; \q katika hizo [tumekuwa] muda mrefu, na je, tutaokolewa?
sw.B: Unatoka kumlaki yule anayefurahia kutenda haki, \q wale wanaokukumbuka wanapotembea katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. \q Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulikasirika, nasi tukatenda dhambi. \q Tumekaa katika dhambi zetu muda mrefu hivi; je, tunaweza kuokolewa?
sw.R: Unawakaribisha watu wanaofurahi kutenda yaliyo haki \q na wanaokumbuka jinsi unavyotaka waishi. Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulikasirika, nasi tukaendelea kutenda dhambi. \q Tumekuwa tukitenda dhambi kwa muda mrefu. Tunawezaje kuokolewa kamwe?

vi.L: Ngài đón gặp [người] vui mừng làm điều công chính, \q [những người] nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong các đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nổi giận, và chúng con đã phạm tội; \q chúng con [đã ở] trong đó lâu, và chúng con sẽ được cứu sao?
vi.B: Ngài đi ra đón người vui thích làm điều công chính, \q những người nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khi bước đi trong đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nổi giận, vì chúng con đã phạm tội. \q Chúng con đã ở mãi trong tội lỗi; làm sao chúng con được cứu?
vi.R: Ngài đón tiếp những người vui lòng làm điều công chính \q và nhớ đến cách {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn họ sống. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nổi giận, và chúng con cứ tiếp tục phạm tội. \q Chúng con đã phạm tội từ lâu rồi. Làm sao chúng con có thể được cứu?

ko.L: 주님께서는 기뻐하며 의를 행하는 자, \q 주님의 길에서 주님을 기억하는 자들을 만나 주십니다. \q 보십시오, 주님께서 진노하셨고, 저희는 죄를 지었습니다. \q 저희가 오랫동안 그 [죄] 가운데 있었으니, 저희가 구원을 받겠습니까?
ko.B: 주님께서는 즐거이 의를 행하는 사람, \q 주님의 길을 걸으며 주님을 기억하는 사람들을 만나러 나오십니다. \q 그러나 주님께서 진노하셨고, 저희는 죄를 지었습니다. \q 저희가 이토록 오래 죄 가운데 머물렀으니, 저희가 구원받을 수 있겠습니까?
ko.R: 주님께서는 기쁘게 옳은 일을 하는 사람들을 반겨 주십니다. \q 주님께서 원하시는 대로 사는 것을 기억하는 사람들을 반겨 주십니다. 그러나 주님께서 노하셨고, 저희는 계속 죄를 지었습니다. \q 저희는 오랫동안 죄를 지어 왔습니다. 저희가 어떻게 구원받을 수 있겠습니까?

decisions.choice: righteousness: what is right, right conduct
decisions.reason: Here the word is the right way of living that God welcomes, not a status before God.

decisions.choice: in them a long time, and will we be saved?: we have stayed in our sins so long; can we still be saved?
alternatives: in your ways is lasting life, and we will be saved
decisions.reason: The line is short and hard. "In them" is read as the sins just named, "a long time" as how long the people have stayed in them, and the last words as a question of near despair. Others read "in your ways [is] lasting life, and we will be saved", taking "them" as God's ways. The Septuagint reads differently again ("therefore we went astray").

decisions.choice: you were angry, and we sinned: anger and sin are set side by side
decisions.reason: The two clauses are simply joined. God's anger answered the people's sin, and under that anger they went on sinning (verse 6).

decisions.choice: in our sins
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "them" refers to, following the reading in m2.

decisions.choice: do what is right; remember how you want them to live
decisions.reason: Readable says "what is right" for righteousness as right conduct (m1), and explains "remember you in your ways" as keeping to the way God wants people to live.

source.text: וַנְּהִ֤י כַטָּמֵא֙ כֻּלָּ֔נוּ וּכְבֶ֥גֶד עִדִּ֖ים כָּל־צִדְקֹתֵ֑ינוּ וַנָּ֤בֶל כֶּֽעָלֶה֙ כֻּלָּ֔נוּ וַעֲוֺנֵ֖נוּ כָּר֥וּחַ יִשָּׂאֻֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And we have become like the unclean [one], all of us, and like a garment of menstruations [are] all our righteousnesses, and we have withered like the leaf, all of us, and our iniquities like the wind carry us away.

en.L: And we have become like the unclean [one], all of us, \q and like a menstrual garment [are] all our righteous deeds; \q and we have withered like the leaf, all of us, \q and our iniquities, like the wind, carry us away.
en.B: We have all turned into something unclean; \q our righteous deeds, every one, are like a cloth soiled by a woman's monthly blood. \q We fade like leaves, all of us, \q and our guilt carries us off like the wind.
en.R: All of us have become unclean. \q Even all the righteous things we do are like a cloth stained with a woman's monthly blood. \q We all dry up like dead leaves, \q and our sins blow us away like the wind.

es.L: Y todos nosotros hemos llegado a ser como el impuro, \q y como trapo de menstruación [son] todas nuestras obras justas; \q y nos hemos marchitado como la hoja, todos nosotros, \q y nuestras iniquidades, como el viento, nos arrastran.
es.B: Todos nos hemos vuelto algo impuro; \q todas nuestras obras justas son como un paño manchado con la sangre del período de una mujer. \q Todos nos marchitamos como hojas, \q y nuestra culpa nos arrastra como el viento.
es.R: Todos nosotros nos hemos vuelto impuros. \q Aun todas las cosas buenas que hacemos son como un trapo manchado con la sangre del período de una mujer. \q Todos nos secamos como hojas muertas, \q y nuestros pecados nos arrastran como el viento.

fr.L: Et nous sommes devenus comme l’impur, nous tous, \q et comme un vêtement souillé des règles [sont] toutes nos justices ; \q et nous nous sommes fanés comme la feuille, nous tous, \q et nos fautes, comme le vent, nous emportent.
fr.B: Nous sommes tous devenus comme une chose impure ; \q toutes nos œuvres justes sont comme un linge taché du sang des règles d’une femme. \q Nous nous fanons tous comme des feuilles, \q et nos fautes nous emportent comme le vent.
fr.R: Nous sommes tous devenus impurs. \q Même toutes les bonnes choses que nous faisons sont comme un linge taché par le sang des règles d’une femme. \q Nous séchons tous comme des feuilles mortes, \q et nos péchés nous emportent comme le vent.

sw.L: Na sisi sote tumekuwa kama [mtu] aliye najisi, \q na matendo yetu yote ya haki [ni] kama nguo ya hedhi; \q nasi sote tumenyauka kama jani, \q na maovu yetu, kama upepo, yanatupeperusha.
sw.B: Sote tumegeuka kuwa kitu kilicho najisi; \q matendo yetu ya haki, kila moja, ni kama kitambaa kilichochafuliwa na damu ya mwezi ya mwanamke. \q Tunanyauka kama majani, sote, \q na hatia yetu inatupeperusha kama upepo.
sw.R: Sote tumekuwa najisi. \q Hata mambo yote ya haki tunayoyatenda ni kama kitambaa kilichotiwa madoa ya damu ya mwezi ya mwanamke. \q Sote tunakauka kama majani yaliyokufa, \q na dhambi zetu zinatupeperusha kama upepo.

vi.L: Và hết thảy chúng con đã trở nên như [kẻ] ô uế, \q và mọi việc công chính của chúng con như chiếc áo dính máu kinh nguyệt; \q và hết thảy chúng con đã héo tàn như chiếc lá, \q và những tội ác của chúng con, như gió, cuốn chúng con đi.
vi.B: Hết thảy chúng con đều đã thành ô uế; \q mọi việc công chính của chúng con chẳng khác nào miếng vải dơ bẩn vì kinh nguyệt của người đàn bà. \q Hết thảy chúng con tàn úa như chiếc lá, \q và tội lỗi chúng con cuốn chúng con đi như gió.
vi.R: Hết thảy chúng con đã trở nên ô uế. \q Ngay cả mọi việc công chính chúng con làm cũng như miếng vải dính máu kinh nguyệt của người đàn bà. \q Hết thảy chúng con khô héo như lá chết, \q và tội lỗi chúng con thổi chúng con đi như gió.

ko.L: 저희는 모두 부정한 자처럼 되었고, \q 저희의 모든 의로운 행위는 월경으로 더러워진 옷 같으며, \q 저희는 모두 잎사귀처럼 시들었고, \q 저희의 죄악이 바람처럼 저희를 날려 갑니다.
ko.B: 저희는 모두 부정한 것이 되었습니다. \q 저희의 의로운 행위는 하나같이 여자의 달거리 피로 더러워진 천과 같습니다. \q 저희는 모두 나뭇잎처럼 시들고, \q 저희의 죄가 바람처럼 저희를 휩쓸어 갑니다.
ko.R: 저희는 모두 부정하게 되었습니다. \q 저희가 하는 의로운 일들조차 모두 여자의 달거리 피가 묻은 천과 같습니다. \q 저희는 모두 마른 잎처럼 시들어 버립니다. \q 저희의 죄가 바람처럼 저희를 날려 버립니다.

decisions.choice: a garment of menstruation: a cloth stained by a woman's monthly flow, which made it ritually unclean
decisions.reason: Under the law a woman's monthly flow made her, and what she lay or sat on, ritually unclean for a time (Leviticus 15:19-24). This was not a sin, and the picture does not shame women. It says that even the people's best deeds carry impurity and cannot bring them near to God. The phrase is often rendered "filthy rags", which hides the image.

decisions.choice: the unclean: someone ritually unclean, who must keep away from the holy
decisions.reason: The word is used of the person with a skin disease who must cry out "Unclean, unclean!" (Leviticus 13:45; compare 6:5; 52:1). The whole people now stand where that person stood.

decisions.choice: our righteousnesses: our righteous deeds
decisions.reason: The plural means acts of righteousness, the good things the people do (compare 33:15; Ezekiel 3:20).

decisions.choice: withered like a leaf, carried off by the wind: life fading and swept away
decisions.reason: A dry leaf falls and is blown away (1:30; 40:7-8; Psalm 1:4). Their sins are the wind that drives them off.

decisions.choice: a cloth soiled (stained) by a woman's monthly blood
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the cloth plainly. Balanced and Readable say what it is in respectful, everyday words rather than a euphemism.

decisions.choice: trapo de menstruación; paño manchado con la sangre del período de una mujer
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names a menstrual cloth, ritually unclean under the law (Leviticus 15:19-24); Spanish says so plainly, as the English does, rather than the traditional "trapo de inmundicia".

decisions.choice: nguo ya hedhi (Literal); kitambaa kilichochafuliwa na damu ya mwezi ya mwanamke (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names a cloth stained by a woman's monthly flow, which made it ritually unclean (meaning decision m1); Swahili names it plainly and respectfully rather than with the vaguer "unclean garment" of familiar versions.

decisions.choice: "un vêtement souillé des règles" (L), "un linge taché du sang des règles d'une femme" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English and its footnote, French names the menstrual cloth plainly and respectfully instead of a vague "vêtement souillé", which hides the point: ritual uncleanness, not dirt.

decisions.choice: "áo dính máu kinh nguyệt"; "miếng vải dơ bẩn vì kinh nguyệt"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase as a menstrual cloth, a thing ritually unclean; Vietnamese says so plainly rather than with the familiar "filthy rags".

decisions.choice: "월경으로 더러워진 옷" (L), "여자의 달거리 피로 더러워진 천" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the menstrual cloth, which made a person ritually unclean (m1), and the English note keeps it against the familiar "filthy rags"; Korean says it plainly in the same way.

source.text: וְאֵין־קוֹרֵ֣א בְשִׁמְךָ֔ מִתְעוֹרֵ֖ר לְהַחֲזִ֣יק בָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־הִסְתַּ֤רְתָּ פָנֶ֨יךָ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וַתְּמוּגֵ֖נוּ בְּיַד־עֲוֺנֵֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And there [is] no one calling on your name, rousing himself to take hold of you, for you have hidden your face from us and you have melted us in the hand of our iniquity.

en.L: And there [is] no one who calls on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, \q who rouses himself to take hold of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have hidden {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face from us \q and have melted us in the hand of our iniquity.
en.B: Not one of us calls on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name; \q no one stirs to hold on to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have hidden {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face from us \q and let us melt away in the grip of our guilt.
en.R: Nobody prays to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q and nobody makes an effort to hold on to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q That is because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have turned away from us. \q You have let our sins destroy us.

es.L: Y no hay quien invoque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, \q que se despierte para asirse de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has escondido de nosotros {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, \q y nos has derretido en mano de nuestra iniquidad.
es.B: Ninguno de nosotros invoca {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre; \q nadie se esfuerza por aferrarse a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has escondido de nosotros {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro \q y nos has dejado deshacernos en las garras de nuestra culpa.
es.R: Nadie {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ora, \q y nadie hace el esfuerzo de aferrarse a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Esto es porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} te has apartado de nosotros. \q Has dejado que nuestros pecados nos destruyan.

fr.L: Et il n’y [a] personne qui invoque {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, \q qui se réveille pour s’attacher à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; \q car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous as caché {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, \q et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous as fait fondre par la main de notre faute.
fr.B: Personne n’invoque {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom ; \q personne ne se secoue pour s’attacher à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous as caché {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face \q et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous as laissés fondre sous l’emprise de nos fautes.
fr.R: Personne ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} prie, \q et personne ne fait d’effort pour s’attacher à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q C’est parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} t’es détourné de nous. \q Tu as laissé nos péchés nous détruire.

sw.L: Wala hakuna anayeliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, \q anayejiamsha ili kukushika; \q kwa maana umetuficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} \q na kutuyeyusha mkononi mwa uovu wetu.
sw.B: Hakuna hata mmoja wetu anayeliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; \q hakuna anayejitahidi kukushikilia. \q Kwa maana umetuficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} \q na kutuacha tuyeyuke katika mshiko wa hatia yetu.
sw.R: Hakuna anayekuomba, \q wala hakuna anayejitahidi kukushikilia. \q Hiyo ni kwa sababu umegeuka mbali nasi. \q Umeziacha dhambi zetu zituangamize.

vi.L: Và chẳng có ai kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q chẳng ai tự thức dậy để nắm lấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ẩn mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi chúng con \q và làm cho chúng con tan chảy trong tay tội ác của chúng con.
vi.B: Không một ai trong chúng con kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q chẳng ai thức tỉnh để níu lấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ẩn mặt khỏi chúng con \q và để chúng con tan chảy trong vòng kìm kẹp của tội lỗi mình.
vi.R: Chẳng ai cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và chẳng ai cố gắng níu lấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Đó là vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã quay mặt khỏi chúng con. \q Ngài đã để tội lỗi chúng con hủy diệt chúng con.

ko.L: 주님의 이름을 부르는 자가 없고, \q 스스로 일어나 주님을 붙잡는 자도 없습니다. \q 주님께서 저희에게서 주님의 얼굴을 숨기시고, \q 저희를 저희 죄악의 손에서 녹아 버리게 하셨기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 저희 가운데 주님의 이름을 부르는 사람이 하나도 없고, \q 마음을 일으켜 주님을 붙드는 사람도 없습니다. \q 주님께서 저희에게서 얼굴을 숨기시고, \q 저희가 저희 죄의 손아귀에서 녹아 없어지게 하셨기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 아무도 주님께 기도하지 않습니다. \q 아무도 주님을 붙잡으려고 애쓰지 않습니다. \q 그것은 주님께서 저희에게서 얼굴을 돌리셨기 때문입니다. \q 주님께서 저희의 죄가 저희를 망하게 내버려 두셨습니다.

decisions.choice: you have hidden your face: God has withdrawn his favor and presence
decisions.reason: To hide the face is to turn away and give no help (8:17; 54:8; Deuteronomy 31:17-18).

decisions.choice: you have melted us in the hand of our iniquity: the Hebrew text is followed
alternatives: you have handed us over to our iniquity
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says God has let the people melt away in the power of their sin. The Septuagint has "you have handed us over" because of our sins, which matches a Hebrew word that differs by little; some follow it. The Hebrew makes good sense and is kept.

decisions.choice: in the hand of: in the power of
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power and control (Genesis 9:2; Judges 2:14). Their own guilt holds them.

decisions.choice: prays to you; turned away from us
decisions.reason: Readable explains "calls on your name" as praying and "hidden your face" as turning away.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אָבִ֣ינוּ אָ֑תָּה אֲנַ֤חְנוּ הַחֹ֨מֶר֙ וְאַתָּ֣ה יֹצְרֵ֔נוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדְךָ֖ כֻּלָּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, Yahweh, our father [are] you; we [are] the clay, and you [are] our former, and the work of your hand [are] we all.

en.L: And now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] our Father; \q we [are] the clay, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] our potter, \q and the work of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand [are] we all.
en.B: But now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are our Father. \q We are the clay, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} the potter who shaped us; \q every one of us is what {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand has made.
en.R: But {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are our Father. \q We are like clay, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are like a potter who shapes the clay. \q You made every one of us with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own hands.

es.L: Y ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [eres] nuestro Padre; \q nosotros [somos] el barro, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [eres] nuestro alfarero, \q y obra de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano [somos] todos nosotros.
es.B: Pero ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres nuestro Padre. \q Nosotros somos el barro, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} el alfarero que nos formó; \q cada uno de nosotros es lo que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano ha hecho.
es.R: Pero {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres nuestro Padre. \q Somos como el barro, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres como un alfarero que le da forma al barro. \q Tú nos hiciste a cada uno de nosotros con {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} propias manos.

fr.L: Et maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [es] notre Père ; \q nous [sommes] l’argile, et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, notre potier, \q et l’œuvre de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main, [c’est] nous tous.
fr.B: Pourtant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es notre Père. \q Nous sommes l’argile, et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, le potier qui nous a façonnés ; \q nous tous, nous sommes l’ouvrage de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main.
fr.R: Mais, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es notre Père. \q Nous sommes comme de l’argile, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es comme un potier qui façonne l’argile. \q Tu nous as tous faits de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} propres mains.

sw.L: Na sasa, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [ni] Baba yetu; \q sisi [ni] udongo, nawe [ni] mfinyanzi wetu, \q na kazi ya mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [ni] sisi sote.
sw.B: Lakini sasa, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni Baba yetu. \q Sisi ni udongo, nawe ni mfinyanzi aliyetufinyanga; \q kila mmoja wetu ni kile ambacho mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} umekifanya.
sw.R: Lakini Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni Baba yetu. \q Sisi ni kama udongo, nawe ni kama mfinyanzi anayefinyanga udongo. \q Uliwafanya kila mmoja wetu kwa mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mwenyewe.

vi.L: Nhưng bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Cha chúng con; \q chúng con [là] đất sét, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] thợ gốm của chúng con, \q và hết thảy chúng con [là] công việc của tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Nhưng giờ đây, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Cha chúng con. \q Chúng con là đất sét, còn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là thợ gốm đã nắn nên chúng con; \q mỗi người chúng con đều là công việc tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm ra.
vi.R: Nhưng lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Cha chúng con. \q Chúng con như đất sét, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như người thợ gốm nắn đất sét. \q Chính tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm nên mỗi người chúng con.

ko.L: 그러나 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 저희의 아버지이십니다. \q 저희는 진흙이요, 주님은 저희의 토기장이이시며, \q 저희는 모두 주님의 손으로 만드신 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러나 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 저희의 아버지이십니다. \q 저희는 진흙이고, 주님은 저희를 빚으신 토기장이이십니다. \q 저희는 모두 주님의 손으로 지으신 작품입니다.
ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 저희의 아버지이십니다. \q 저희는 진흙과 같고, 주님은 진흙으로 그릇을 빚는 사람과 같으십니다. \q 주님께서 주님의 손으로 저희를 하나하나 만드셨습니다.

decisions.choice: you are our Father: God who made his people and cares for them as his own
decisions.reason: The prayer already called on God as Father in 63:16. He is Father as the one who brought Israel into being and owns it (Deuteronomy 32:6; Malachi 2:10).

decisions.choice: we are the clay, you our potter: we belong to the one who formed us
decisions.reason: The verb "form" is the potter's word, used when God forms the man from dust (Genesis 2:7). Isaiah uses the picture elsewhere to rebuke those who argue with their maker (29:16; 45:9); here it is a plea: you made us, so do not abandon your work (Jeremiah 18:1-6; Romans 9:20-21).

decisions.choice: like clay; like a potter who shapes the clay
decisions.reason: Readable marks the picture as a comparison so a young reader follows it.

decisions.choice: "thợ gốm" (potter)
decisions.reason: As the terms note settles, following Romans 9:21.

source.text: אַל־תִּקְצֹ֤ף יְהוָה֙ עַד־מְאֹ֔ד וְאַל־לָעַ֖ד תִּזְכֹּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן הֵ֥ן הַבֶּט־נָ֖א עַמְּךָ֥ כֻלָּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not be angry, Yahweh, to muchness, and do not forever remember iniquity; look, please, your people [are] we all.

en.L: Do not be angry, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, to the utmost, \q and do not remember iniquity forever. \q Look, please: {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people [are] we all.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, do not let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger go too far, \q and do not keep our guilt in mind forever. \q Look at us, we beg {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}: all of us are {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, please do not stay so angry with us. \q Do not remember our sins forever. \q Please look at us. We are all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people.

es.L: No te enojes, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en extremo, \q ni te acuerdes para siempre de la iniquidad. \q Mira, te rogamos: {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo [somos] todos nosotros.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no dejes que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enojo vaya demasiado lejos, \q ni tengas presente nuestra culpa para siempre. \q Míranos, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lo rogamos: todos nosotros somos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por favor, no sigas tan enojado con nosotros. \q No te acuerdes de nuestros pecados para siempre. \q Por favor, míranos. Todos somos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo.

fr.L: Ne t’irrite pas, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à l’extrême, \q et ne te souviens pas toujours de la faute. \q Voici, regarde donc : {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, [c’est] nous tous.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ne laisse pas {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère aller trop loin, \q et ne garde pas toujours le souvenir de nos fautes. \q Regarde-nous, nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en supplions : nous sommes tous {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, ne reste pas si en colère contre nous. \q Ne te souviens pas toujours de nos péchés. \q Regarde-nous, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît. Nous sommes tous {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple.

sw.L: Usikasirike, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kupita kiasi, \q wala usikumbuke uovu milele. \q Tazama, tafadhali: sisi sote [ni] watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usiiache hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} izidi kiasi, \q wala usiikumbuke hatia yetu milele. \q Tutazame, tunakusihi: sisi sote ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, tafadhali usiendelee kutukasirikia hivyo. \q Usizikumbuke dhambi zetu milele. \q Tafadhali tutazame. Sisi sote ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đừng giận quá mức, \q và đừng nhớ tội ác mãi mãi. \q Xin hãy nhìn xem: hết thảy chúng con [là] dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đừng để cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi quá mức, \q và xin đừng ghi nhớ tội lỗi chúng con mãi mãi. \q Xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhìn xem, chúng con nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: hết thảy chúng con đều là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đừng giận chúng con mãi như vậy. \q Xin đừng nhớ tội lỗi chúng con mãi mãi. \q Xin hãy nhìn chúng con. Hết thảy chúng con đều là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 너무 심하게 진노하지 마시고, \q 죄악을 영원히 기억하지 마십시오. \q 보십시오, 저희는 모두 주님의 백성입니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 진노를 끝까지 쏟지 마시고, \q 저희의 죄를 영원히 마음에 두지 마십시오. \q 부디 저희를 보아 주십시오. 저희는 모두 주님의 백성입니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제발 저희에게 그렇게 노여워하지 마십시오. \q 저희의 죄를 영원히 기억하지 마십시오. \q 제발 저희를 보아 주십시오. 저희는 모두 주님의 백성입니다.

decisions.choice: remember iniquity: hold sin against someone and punish it
decisions.reason: For God to remember sin is to act on it; to forget it is to forgive (43:25; Psalm 79:8; Jeremiah 31:34).

decisions.choice: to muchness: to the utmost, beyond measure
decisions.reason: The same words close the prayer in verse 11, so the plea that God's anger not go too far frames the end of it.

decisions.choice: we are all your people: an appeal to God's covenant
decisions.reason: The people base their plea not on their deeds (verse 5) but on belonging to God (63:19; Exodus 33:13).

decisions.choice: our guilt; our sins
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whose iniquity is meant, as the prayer's context makes plain.

source.text: עָרֵ֥י קָדְשְׁךָ֖ הָי֣וּ מִדְבָּ֑ר צִיּוֹן֙ מִדְבָּ֣ר הָיָ֔תָה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם שְׁמָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: The cities of your holiness have become a wilderness; Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

en.L: The cities of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holiness have become a wilderness; \q Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
en.B: Your holy cities have turned into open wilderness. \q Zion is now a wilderness; Jerusalem lies desolate.
en.R: Your holy cities have become like a desert. \q Zion is a desert, and Jerusalem is empty and ruined.

es.L: Las ciudades de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santidad se han vuelto un desierto; \q Sion se ha vuelto un desierto, Jerusalén una desolación.
es.B: Tus ciudades santas se han convertido en un desierto abierto. \q Sion es ahora un desierto; Jerusalén está desolada.
es.R: Tus ciudades santas se han vuelto como un desierto. \q Sion es un desierto, y Jerusalén está vacía y en ruinas.

fr.L: Les villes de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sainteté sont devenues un désert ; \q Sion est devenue un désert, Jérusalem une désolation.
fr.B: Tes villes saintes sont devenues un désert. \q Sion n’est plus qu’un désert ; Jérusalem est dévastée.
fr.R: Tes villes saintes sont devenues comme un désert. \q Sion est un désert, et Jérusalem est vide et en ruine.

sw.L: Miji ya utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} imekuwa nyika; \q Sayuni umekuwa nyika, Yerusalemu ukiwa.
sw.B: Miji {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mitakatifu imegeuka kuwa nyika tupu. \q Sayuni sasa ni nyika; Yerusalemu umekaa ukiwa.
sw.R: Miji {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mitakatifu imekuwa kama jangwa. \q Sayuni ni jangwa, na Yerusalemu uko tupu na umeharibiwa.

vi.L: Các thành thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở nên hoang mạc; \q Si-ôn đã trở nên hoang mạc, Giê-ru-sa-lem thành nơi hoang vu.
vi.B: Các thành thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã biến thành đồng hoang. \q Si-ôn nay là hoang mạc; Giê-ru-sa-lem nằm hoang vắng.
vi.R: Các thành thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở nên như sa mạc. \q Si-ôn là sa mạc, và Giê-ru-sa-lem bị bỏ trống và đổ nát.

ko.L: 주님의 거룩한 성읍들이 광야가 되었습니다. \q 시온이 광야가 되었고, 예루살렘이 황폐해졌습니다.
ko.B: 주님의 거룩한 성읍들이 거친 광야로 변했습니다. \q 시온은 이제 광야가 되었고, 예루살렘은 황폐해졌습니다.
ko.R: 주님의 거룩한 성읍들이 사막처럼 되었습니다. \q 시온은 사막이 되었고, 예루살렘은 텅 비고 무너졌습니다.

decisions.choice: your holy cities: the towns of Judah, the land that belongs to God
decisions.reason: The land is God's holy land, so its towns are his (Zechariah 2:16; Psalm 78:54).

decisions.choice: wilderness, desolation: Jerusalem lies ruined and empty
decisions.reason: The prayer speaks as if Jerusalem and the temple already lie in ruins, as they did after the Babylonians destroyed the city in 586 BC (2 Kings 25:8-10). A wilderness is land without settled people, not only sand.

decisions.choice: desert
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday word for empty land where no one lives.

source.text: בֵּ֧ית קָדְשֵׁ֣נוּ וְתִפְאַרְתֵּ֗נוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִֽלְל֨וּךָ֙ אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ הָיָ֖ה לִשְׂרֵ֣פַת אֵ֑שׁ וְכָל־מַחֲמַדֵּ֖ינוּ הָיָ֥ה לְחָרְבָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: The house of our holiness and our splendor, where our fathers praised you, has become a burning of fire, and all our desirable things have become a ruin.

en.L: The house of our holiness and our splendor, where our fathers praised {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q has become [something] burned by fire, \q and all our precious [things] have become a ruin.
en.B: Our holy and splendid house, where our ancestors once praised {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q has been given to the fire, \q and every precious thing we had is now rubble.
en.R: The holy temple we were so proud of, where our ancestors praised {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, has burned down. \q All the things we loved are ruined.

es.L: La casa de nuestra santidad y de nuestra gloria, donde nuestros padres {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabaron, \q ha sido [pasto] del fuego, \q y todas nuestras cosas preciosas se han vuelto ruina.
es.B: Nuestra casa santa y espléndida, donde nuestros antepasados {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alababan, \q ha sido entregada al fuego, \q y todo lo precioso que teníamos es ahora escombros.
es.R: El templo santo del que estábamos tan orgullosos, donde nuestros antepasados {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alababan, se ha quemado. \q Todas las cosas que amábamos están arruinadas.

fr.L: La maison de notre sainteté et de notre splendeur, où nos pères {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ont loué, \q est devenue la proie des flammes, \q et tout ce qui nous était précieux est devenu une ruine.
fr.B: Notre maison sainte et splendide, où nos ancêtres {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louaient, \q a été livrée au feu, \q et tout ce que nous avions de précieux n’est plus que décombres.
fr.R: Le temple saint dont nous étions si fiers, où nos ancêtres {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louaient, a brûlé. \q Toutes les choses que nous aimions sont en ruine.

sw.L: Nyumba ya utakatifu wetu na fahari yetu, ambamo baba zetu walikusifu, \q imekuwa [kitu] kilichoteketezwa kwa moto, \q na vitu vyetu vyote vya thamani vimekuwa magofu.
sw.B: Nyumba yetu takatifu na yenye fahari, ambamo babu zetu walikusifu zamani, \q imetolewa kwa moto, \q na kila kitu cha thamani tulichokuwa nacho sasa ni kifusi.
sw.R: Hekalu takatifu tulilojivunia, ambamo babu zetu walikusifu, limeteketea kwa moto. \q Vitu vyote tulivyovipenda vimeharibiwa.

vi.L: Nhà thánh và vinh hiển của chúng con, nơi tổ phụ chúng con đã ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q đã bị lửa thiêu đốt, \q và mọi [vật] quý báu của chúng con đã thành đống đổ nát.
vi.B: Ngôi nhà thánh và huy hoàng của chúng con, nơi tổ phụ chúng con từng ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q đã bị phó cho lửa thiêu, \q và mọi vật quý giá chúng con có giờ chỉ còn là đống gạch vụn.
vi.R: Đền thờ thánh mà chúng con rất hãnh diện, nơi tổ tiên chúng con đã ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đã bị thiêu rụi. \q Mọi thứ chúng con yêu quý đều đã đổ nát.

ko.L: 저희 조상들이 주님을 찬양하던 저희의 거룩하고 영화로운 집이 \q 불에 타 버렸고, \q 저희가 귀하게 여기던 것들이 모두 폐허가 되었습니다.
ko.B: 저희 조상들이 주님을 찬양하던 거룩하고 영화로운 저희의 집이 \q 불에 넘겨졌고, \q 저희가 아끼던 것은 모두 돌무더기가 되었습니다.
ko.R: 저희가 자랑스럽게 여기던 거룩한 성전, 저희 조상들이 주님을 찬양하던 그곳이 불에 타 버렸습니다. \q 저희가 사랑하던 것들이 모두 무너졌습니다.

decisions.choice: the house of our holiness: the temple in Jerusalem, burned with fire
decisions.reason: The Babylonians burned the house of the LORD in 586 BC (2 Kings 25:9; Psalm 74:7). It was the people's holy place and their pride.

decisions.choice: our desirable things: our treasures, everything we prized
decisions.reason: The word is used of precious things lost when Jerusalem fell (Lamentations 1:10-11; 2:4). It may mean the temple's treasures or all the city's pleasant places.

decisions.choice: temple
decisions.reason: Readable names the house the prayer means.

records.literal_gloss: Over these [things] will you restrain yourself, Yahweh? Will you be silent and afflict us to muchness?

en.L: Over these [things] will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hold {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} back, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}? \q Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be silent and afflict us to the utmost?
en.B: With all this before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} still hold {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} back? \q Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep silent and afflict us so severely?
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, after seeing all this, will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} still do nothing? \q Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} stay silent and keep making us suffer so much?

es.L: ¿Ante estas [cosas] te contendrás, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}? \q ¿Callarás y nos afligirás en extremo?
es.B: Con todo esto delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿todavía te contendrás? \q ¿Seguirás callado y nos afligirás tan duramente?
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, después de ver todo esto, ¿seguirás sin hacer nada? \q ¿Te quedarás callado y seguirás haciéndonos sufrir tanto?

fr.L: Devant ces [choses] {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} retiendras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? \q Te tairas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} et nous affligeras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} à l’extrême ?
fr.B: Devant tout cela, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} retiendras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} encore ? \q Garderas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le silence et nous affligeras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} si durement ?
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, après avoir vu tout cela, ne feras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} toujours rien ? \q Vas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rester silencieux et continuer à nous faire souffrir autant ?

sw.L: Juu ya [mambo] haya utajizuia, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? \q Je, utanyamaza na kututesa kupita kiasi?
sw.B: Ukiona yote haya, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, je, bado utajizuia? \q Je, utaendelea kunyamaza na kututesa vikali hivi?
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, baada ya kuona haya yote, je, bado hutafanya kitu? \q Je, utaendelea kunyamaza na kutufanya tuteseke sana hivi?

vi.L: Trước những [điều] này {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn kìm giữ mình sao, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}? \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ im lặng và hạ chúng con xuống quá mức sao?
vi.B: Trước mọi điều ấy, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn còn kìm giữ mình sao? \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn im lặng và để chúng con khốn khổ đến thế sao?
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, sau khi thấy mọi điều này, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn không làm gì sao? \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn im lặng và cứ để chúng con chịu khổ nhiều đến thế sao?

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 이런 일들에도 주님께서는 참고만 계시겠습니까? \q 잠잠히 계시면서 저희를 이토록 심하게 괴롭게 하시겠습니까?
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 이 모든 것을 보시고도 주님께서는 여전히 참고만 계시겠습니까? \q 잠잠히 계시면서 저희를 이렇게 심하게 괴롭히시겠습니까?
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 이 모든 것을 보시고도 아무것도 하지 않으시겠습니까? \q 계속 잠잠히 계시면서 저희가 이렇게 고통을 당하게 하시겠습니까?

decisions.choice: will you hold back ... will you be silent: the prayer ends with questions
decisions.reason: The prayer that began at 63:7 ends without an answer of its own. The LORD replies in chapter 65: "I will not keep silent" (65:6).

decisions.choice: restrain yourself: hold back from acting
decisions.reason: The same verb is used when God says he has long held himself back (42:14) and when the prayer asks where his compassion has gone (63:15).

decisions.choice: still do nothing; keep making us suffer
decisions.reason: Readable says what holding back means here (not acting to help) and puts "afflict" in plain words.
